app_description: Explore, prepare, and run every Startpack API operation from one local workspace.
identity_vault_description: Credentials stay in this browser tab only.
vault_ready_tab_note: Stored only in this browser tab.
vault_ready_cookie_note: CSRF is added automatically to mutations.
vault_idle_note: Sign in with one of the demo accounts.
vault_idle_cookie_note: Sign in with a demo account; the HTTPS profile is required.
search_endpoints: Search by route, method, or purpose
no_endpoints_description: Clear the search or switch to another group.
select_endpoint_description: Choose an operation from the catalog to prepare its request.
destructive_description: Review the request before continuing. This change may be irreversible.
no_response_description: The result appears here after you send a request.
run_social_flow_note: Runs authorize and callback in sequence.
fill_totp: Put the live TOTP code in the body
clipboard_denied_description: Check the browser permission and try again.
invalid_json_description: Fix the syntax and try again.
request_failed: The request could not be sent
request_failed_description: Check the API origin, HTTPS certificate, and whether the API is running. {reason}
vault_cleared_description: Server sessions must still be logged out or revoked.
scenario_ready_description: Two sessions were created; the newest one is in the vault.
scenario_failed: The scenario could not be prepared
scenario_failed_description: The account may require MFA, or the API may be unreachable.
demo_key_ready_description: The admin fixture scopes are ready.
mfa_required_description: The ticket is in the vault; complete sign-in with a live code.
oauth_ready_description: No request was made to the real provider.
oauth_failed_description: Make sure the API is running in Development.
webauthn_unsupported_description: Use a current browser in a secure localhost context.
passkey_registered_description: It is now visible from the passkey list endpoint.
passkey_login_ready_description: The issued credentials are in the vault.
totp_missing_description: Run the enrollment endpoint successfully first.
response_notice_mfa: Password verified; MFA is required. The ticket is in the vault.
response_notice_cookie: Cookie mode is active. Protected endpoints can now use HttpOnly cookies directly.
response_notice_tokens: Access and refresh tokens were saved to this tab's identity vault.
response_notice_key: The new API key was saved. The server will not show its secret again.
response_notice_totp: The TOTP secret is shown once. The workbench is now generating a live six-digit code.
response_notice_recovery: Recovery codes are shown once. Copy this response now.
